## Some functions
#1)
.fit.stats.bin <- function(fit, y = NULL, x = NULL, ...)
{
  #### Extract the class of the fitted model
  cfit <- class(fit)
  #### Extract the family
  if ("glm" %in% cfit) { fam <- fit$family$family }
  else if ("glmnet" %in% cfit)
  { 
    if ("classnames" %in% names(fit)) { fam <- "binomial" }
  }
  else 
  {
    fam <- ""
  }
}

#2)
.five.fit.stats<-function(fit)
  
{
  c(R2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    logLik = logLik(fit),
    R2adj = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
    AIC = AIC(fit),
    BIC = BIC(fit))
}

#3)
.glmnet.xmat <- function(formula, data)
{
  #### Extract independent variables
  form <- strsplit(x = as.character(formula(formula)), split = "~", 
    fixed = TRUE)[[3]]
  #### Complete the formula
  form <- formula(paste0(" ~ ", form))
  #### Extract independent variables
  model.matrix(object = form, data = data)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
}

#4)
.cost.cutoff <- function(c01, c10 = 1, c00 = 0, c11 = 0)
{
  1 / (1 + (c01 - c11) / (c10 - c00) )
}

#5)
.classify <- function(x, coff)
{
  as.numeric(x > coff)
}

#6)
.plotcp <- function(x, minline = TRUE, lty = 3, col = 1,
  upper = c("size", "splits", "none"), ...)
{
  dots <- list(...)
  if (!inherits(x, "rpart")) stop("Not a legitimate \"rpart\" object")
  upper <- match.arg(upper)
  p.rpart <- x$cptable
  if (ncol(p.rpart) < 5L)
    stop("'cptable' does not contain cross-validation results")
  xstd <- p.rpart[, 5L]
  xerror <- p.rpart[, 4L]
  nsplit <- p.rpart[, 2L]
  ns <- seq_along(nsplit)
  cp0 <- p.rpart[, 1L]
  #### Original
  ## cp <- sqrt(cp0 * c(Inf, cp0[-length(cp0)]))
  #### Changed
  cp <- cp0
  if (! "ylim" %in% names(dots))
    dots$ylim <- c(min(xerror - xstd) - 0.1, max(xerror + xstd) + 0.1)
  do.call(plot, c(list(ns, xerror, axes = FALSE, xlab = "cp",
    ylab = "X-val Relative Error", type = "o"), dots))
  box()
  axis(2, ...)
  segments(ns, xerror - xstd, ns, xerror + xstd)
  axis(1L, at = ns, labels = as.character(signif(cp, 2L)), ...)
  switch(upper,
    size = {
      axis(3L, at = ns, labels = as.character(nsplit + 1), ...)
      mtext("size of tree", side = 3, line = 3)
    },
    splits = {
      axis(3L, at = ns, labels = as.character(nsplit), ...)
      mtext("number of splits", side = 3, line = 3)
    })
  minpos <- min(seq_along(xerror)[xerror == min(xerror)])
  if (minline) abline(h = (xerror + xstd)[minpos], lty = lty, col = col)
  invisible()
}

#8)
.rf.errorMeasures <- function(fit, data)
{ 
  #### Extract
  ## General
  type <- fit$treetype
  n.trees <- fit$num.trees
  ## Prediction based
  ib <- do.call(what = cbind, args = fit$inbag.counts)
  ## Dependent var
  y <- data[, fit$dependent.variable.name]

  #### Make
  fun.ce <- function(y, pred)
  {
    ans <- y * log(pred) + (1 - y) * log(1 - pred)
    ans[pred < 1e-15] <- log(1e-15) 
    ans[pred > 1 - 1e-15] <- 0
    -mean(ans)
  }
    
  ## IB/OOB
  ob <- ib == 0
  ib <- ib > 0
  ##
  if (type == "Probability estimation")
  {
    y <- as.numeric(levels(y))[y]
    pred <- predict(object = fit, data = data, type = "response", 
      predict.all = TRUE)$predictions[, "1",]
    pred.ib  <- rowSums(pred * ib) / rowSums(ib)
    pred.ob  <- rowSums(pred * ob) / rowSums(ob)
    pred.all <- rowMeans(pred)
    ans <- matrix(NA, 3, 3)
    rownames(ans) <- c("ib", "oob", "all")
    colnames(ans) <- c("me", "ce", "brier")
    ans["ib",  "me"] <- mean( (y != (pred.ib > 0.5) ) )
    ans["oob", "me"] <- mean( (y != (pred.ob > 0.5) ) )
    ans["all", "me"] <- mean( (y != (pred.all > 0.5) ) )
    ans["ib",  "ce"] <- fun.ce(y = y, pred = pred.ib)
    ans["oob", "ce"] <- fun.ce(y = y, pred = pred.ob)
    ans["all", "ce"] <- fun.ce(y = y, pred = pred.all)
    ans["ib",  "brier"] <- mean( (y - pred.ib)^2 )
    ans["oob", "brier"] <- mean( (y - pred.ob)^2 )
    ans["all", "brier"] <- mean( (y - pred.all)^2 )
  }
  else if (type == "Regression")
  {
    pred <- predict(object = fit, data = data, type = "response", 
      predict.all = TRUE)$predictions
    pred.ib  <- rowSums(pred * ib) / rowSums(ib)
    pred.ob  <- rowSums(pred * ob) / rowSums(ob)
    pred.all <- rowMeans(pred)
    ans <- matrix(NA, 3, 3)
    rownames(ans) <- c("ib", "oob", "all")
    colnames(ans) <- c("mse", "rmse", "mae")
    ans["ib",  "mse"] <- mean( (y - pred.ib)^2 )
    ans["oob", "mse"] <- mean( (y - pred.ob)^2 )
    ans["all", "mse"] <- mean( (y - pred.all)^2 )
    ans[, "rmse"] <- sqrt(ans[, "mse"])
    ans["ib",  "mae"] <- mean( abs(y - pred.ib) )
    ans["oob", "mae"] <- mean( abs(y - pred.ob) )
    ans["all", "mae"] <- mean( abs(y - pred.all) )
  }
  else
  {
    stop("Argument 'fit' must have the $treetype component as 'Probability estimation' or 'Regression'")
  }

  #### Answer
  ans
}

#9)
.rf.loss <- function(y, pred, type)
{ 
  #### Settings
  n.trees <- NCOL(pred)

  #### Make
  fun.ce <- function(y, pred)
  {
    ans <- y * log(pred) + (1 - y) * log(1 - pred)
    ans[pred < 1e-15] <- log(1e-15) 
    ans[pred > 1 - 1e-15] <- 0
    -ans
  }
  
  #### Type
  if (type %in% c("me", "ce", "br"))
  {
    y <- as.numeric(levels(y))[y]
    ans <- if (type == "me")
    {
      y != (pred > 0.5)
    }
    else if (type == "ce")
    {
      fun.ce(y = y, pred = pred)
    }
    else if (type == "br")
    {
      (y - pred)^2
    }
    ans <- colMeans(ans)
  }  
  else if (type %in% c("ms", "rm"))
  {
    ans <- colMeans( (y - pred)^2 )
    if (type == "rm")
    {
      ans <- sqrt(ans)
    }
  }
  else
  {
    stop("Argument 'type' must be one among 'rmse', 'mse', 'ce' or 'brier'")
  }
  
  #### Answer
  ans
}

#10)
.rf.errorPlot <- function(fit, data, what = "oob",
  type = c("rmse", "mse", "me", "ce", "brier"))
{ 
  #### Settings
  type <- substr(type[1], 1, 2)
  #### Dependent var
  y <- data[, fit$dependent.variable.name]
  #### Predictions
  pred <- .rf.predict.cum(fit = fit, data = data.train)
  loss <- cbind(
    oob = .rf.loss(y = y, pred = pred$oob, type = type),
    all = .rf.loss(y = y, pred = pred$all, type = type),
    ib = .rf.loss(y = y, pred = pred$ib, type = type) )

  #### Plot
  ## Settings
  ylab <- switch(type,
    rm = "RMSE",
    ms = "MSE",
    me = "Misclassification Error",
    ce = "Cross-Entropy",
    brier = "Brier Score" )
  x <- 1 : NROW(loss)
  text <- c("oob", "all", "ib")
  col <- c("green", "grey", "red")
  names(text) <- names(col) <- text
  ## Select
  loss <- loss[, what, drop = FALSE]
  text <- toupper(text[what])
  col  <- col[what]
  ## Make
  matplot(x = x, y = loss, type = "l", col = col, ylab = ylab, lty = "solid", 
    xlab = "num. trees")
  legend(x = "topright", legend = text, fill = NULL, col = col,
    border = "white", lty = 1, pch = NULL, bty = "o", bg = par("bg"))
  
  #### Answer
  loss 
}

#12)
.yuden.coff <- function(x, pred)
{
  pred.r <- range(pred)
  coff <- seq(from = pred.r[1], to = pred.r[2], by = 0.001)
   #coff <- quantile(x = pred, prob = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.005),
    # names = FALSE)
  if (pred.r[1] > 0) { coff <- c(0, coff) }
  if (pred.r[2] < 1) { coff <- c(coff, 1) }
  roc <- verification::roc.plot(x = x, pred = pred, thresholds = coff, 
    xlab = "FPR", ylab = "TPR", plot = NULL)$plot.data[, , 1]
  yuden <- roc[, 2] - roc[, 3]
  roc <- cbind(roc, yuden)
  ind <- which.max(yuden)
  roc <- as.numeric(roc[ind, ])
  list(coff = roc[1], J = roc[6], tpr = roc[2], fpr = roc[3])
}

#13)
.yuden.coff <- function(x, pred) {
  # Convert factors to numeric if needed
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    x <- as.numeric(as.character(x))
  }
  if (is.factor(pred)) {
    pred <- as.numeric(as.character(pred))
  }
  
  pred.r <- range(pred)
  coff <- seq(from = pred.r[1], to = pred.r[2], by = 0.001)
  
  if (pred.r[1] > 0) { coff <- c(0, coff) }
  if (pred.r[2] < 1) { coff <- c(coff, 1) }
  
  roc <- verification::roc.plot(x = x, pred = pred, thresholds = coff, 
                                xlab = "FPR", ylab = "TPR", plot = NULL)$plot.data[, , 1]
  
  yuden <- roc[, 2] - roc[, 3]
  roc <- cbind(roc, yuden)
  ind <- which.max(yuden)
  roc <- as.numeric(roc[ind, ])
  
  list(coff = roc[1], J = roc[6], tpr = roc[2], fpr = roc[3])
}

#14)
.rpart.cp.1se <- function(fit)
{
  ####
  cptable <- fit$cptable
  #### Position of min(xerror)
  ind <- which.min(cptable[, "xerror"])
  #### Calculation of min(xerror) + xstd
  xerror.threshold <- cptable[ind, "xerror"] + cptable[ind, "xstd"]
  #### Find the position of the smallest xerror among those > xerror.threshold
  ind <- cptable[, "xerror"] > xerror.threshold
  ind <- cptable[, "xerror"] == min(cptable[ind, "xerror"])
  ind <- which(ind)[1]
  #### Answer
  fit$cptable[ind, "CP"]
}

## Training/Test set splits

### Regularized Regression

```{r}
y <- data.train$VAR38

xmat <- .glmnet.xmat(formula = formula(fit.full), data=data.train)

print(dim(xmat))

lambda.all <- exp(seq(from = -10, to = 7, by = .2))

```

#### Ridge

```{r}
alphar <- 0 
fit <- glmnet(x = xmat, y = y, family = "binomial", lambda = lambda.all,
  standardize = TRUE, alpha = alphar)

fit.ridge.all <- fit


##GRAPHS
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(x = fit.ridge.all, xvar="lambda", label=TRUE)  ## lambda
plot(x = fit.ridge.all, xvar = "norm",   label = TRUE) ## L1-norm
plot(x = fit.ridge.all, xvar = "dev",    label = TRUE) ## R^2

##LAMBDA SELECTION
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(x = xmat, y = y, alpha = alphar, lambda = lambda.all,
  family = "binomial", type.measure = "deviance", nfolds = 20)
par( mfrow = c(1,1) )
plot(cvfit)

cat("min(lambda) = ", cvfit$lambda.min, "1se(lambda) = ", cvfit$lambda.1se, "\n")

##FITTING WITH THE BEST LAMBDA
lambda <- cvfit$lambda.1se
fit <- glmnet(x = xmat, y = y, family = "binomial", alpha = alphar,
  lambda = lambda, standardize = TRUE)

lambda.ridge <- lambda
fit.ridge <- fit
```

## RPART

```{r}
control <- rpart.control(minsplit = 10, minbucket = 5, cp = 0, xval = 10, maxdepth = 30)

prob1 <- mean(data.train$VAR38)
parms <- list(prior = c(1 - prob1, prob1), 
  loss = matrix(c(0,1,1,0),2,2),
  split = "gini")

fit <- rpart(formula = form.full, data = data.train, control = control,
  method = "class", parms = parms)


fitRpart <- fit

```

```{r}

cp.threshold <- .rpart.cp.1se(fit = fitRpart)
cp.threshold

fit <- prune(tree = fitRpart, cp = cp.threshold)
printcp(fit)
par(mfrow = c(1,1), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 1))
.plotcp(fit)
par(mfrow = c(1,1), mar = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
fancyRpartPlot(fit, caption = NULL, type = 4)

fit2Rpart <- fit
```

## Cut-off selection

```{r}

y <- data.train$VAR38
yt <- as.numeric(as.character(y))
prop1 <- mean(yt)

pred.full.train <- predict(object = fit.bagging , data=data.train, type="response")$predictions[, "1"]

# 2Average rule
coff.2 <- prop1     
class.av <- .classify(x = pred.full.train, coff = coff.2)
class.av
# 3Quantile rule
coff.3 <- quantile(x = fitted(fit.bagging), prob = 1 - prop1)
coff.3
class.qn <- .classify(x = pred.full.train, coff = coff.3)
class.qn
# 4Cost based rule
coff.4 <- .cost.cutoff(c01 = 5, c10 = 1, c00 = 0, c11 = 0)
coff.4
class.cost <- .classify(x = pred.full.train, coff = coff.4)
class.cost
# 5Yuden point
coff.5 <- .yuden.coff(x = yt, pred =pred.full.train)$coff
coff.5
class.yuden <- .classify(x = pred.full.train, coff=coff.5)
class.yuden
```

Compare the 0/1 proportions in the data with those coming from model classifications.

```{r}
rbind(
  data.train  = prop.table(table(yt, exclude = NULL)),
  class.av    = prop.table(table(class.av, exclude = NULL)),
  class.qn    = prop.table(table(class.qn, exclude = NULL)),
  class.cost  = prop.table(table(class.cost, exclude = NULL)),
  class.yuden = prop.table(table(class.yuden, exclude = NULL)) )
 
```

Set the cut-off value to be used for predictions.

```{r}
yuden <- .yuden.coff(x = yt, pred = pred.full.train)
yuden
coff.sel <- yuden$coff
coff.sel
#coff.sel <- .cost.cutoff(c01 = 5, c10 = 1, c00 = 0, c11 = 0)
#coff.sel
```

## Model performance evaluation (classification based)

I use only bagging model.

```{r}
#### Test data
data <- data.test
y <- data$VAR38
#### Predictions
fit <- fit.bagging
pred <- predict(object = fit, data = data, type = "response")$predictions[, "1"]
head(pred)
coff.sel
class <- .classify(x = pred, coff = coff.sel)
```

Confusion matrix.

```{r}
#### Original
cmat <- table(class = class, true = y, exclude = NULL)
cmat
#### Proportions (conditionally on the classification)
prop.table(cmat, margin = 1)
#### A different way to calculate the confusion matrix with some statistics added
cmat.s <- confusionMatrix(
    data = as.factor(class), reference = as.factor(y),
  positive = "1")
cmat.s
```

## Prediction on live data

```{r}
##   Settings
formula <- VAR38f ~ VAR5 + VAR17 + VAR29 + VAR4 + VAR32 + VAR1 + VAR6 + VAR7 + VAR9 + VAR10 + VAR13 + VAR14 + VAR15 + VAR16 + VAR18 + VAR19 + VAR21 + VAR22 + VAR24 + VAR25 + VAR26 + VAR27 + VAR31 + VAR33 + VAR34 + VAR36 + VAR37

feat <- .features(x = formula)

fit.fin <- fit.bagging
data <- data.orig
##   Model fitting
fit.fin <- ranger(formula = formula, data = data,
  num.trees = 2000, mtry = fit$mtry,
  probability = TRUE,
  min.node.size = fit$min.node.size, min.bucket = 1, max.depth = NULL,
  importance = fit$importance.mode, splitrule = fit$splitrule,
  keep.inbag = TRUE, oob.error = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, seed = 2000)
```

Predict probability.

```{r}
pred.fin <- predict(object = fit.fin, data = data.live, type = "response")$predictions[, "1"]
#pred.fin
#coff.sel
#mean(data$VAR38)

```

Convert to classification.

```{r}
class <- .classify(x = pred.fin, coff = coff.sel)
class
mean(class)
```

Save.

```{r}
### Append predictions to live data
pred <- data.frame(data.live, pred = pred.fin, class = class, check.names = FALSE)
#### Write on a file
file <- "Data-livePredictions.txt"
write.table(x = pred, file = file, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t",
  na = ".", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```
